mapper.select: select bu.f_id as fUserId, bup.f_project_section_id as fId, bu.f_user_name, bu.f_nickname, bup.f_role, bu.f_head_portrait from base_user bu right join base_user_project bup on bup.f_user_id = bu.f_id where bup.f_project_section_id = #{id} and f_is_delete = '0'

select bu.f_id, bu.f_user_name, bu.f_nickname, bup.f_role from base_user bu right join base_user_project bup on bup.f_user_id = bu.f_id where (bup.f_parent_project_id = #{id} or bup.f_project_section_id = #{id}) and f_is_delete = '0'

select bup.f_id, bup.f_parent_project_id, bup.f_project_section_name, bup.f_project_section_id from base_user_project bup where bup.f_is_delete = '0' and bup.f_user_id = #{fId} and bup.f_parent_project_id is null
and bup.f_project_section_name like concat(#{fProjectSectionName}, '%')
order by bup.f_create_time desc

SELECT f_id as fid, f_project_section_id as fprojectSectionId, f_project_section_name as fprojectSectionName, f_parent_project_id as fparentProjectId, f_role as frole FROM base_user_project WHERE f_user_id = #{userId} AND f_is_delete = 0
SELECT f_project_section_id, f_project_section_name FROM base_user_project WHERE f_parent_project_id = #{fProjectSectionId} AND f_is_delete = 0
